The main takeaway from our work is that

the haplotype composition of Jewish populations is not significantly different from other European populations, and that the hapltype motifs proposed in the past as Jewish ancestry markers are not specific to the Jewish populations.
haplotypes with a given motif are not necessarily associated with a given ancestry and the same motif may be found in different populations.
